### Al Smith Discusses How Simplicity Drives Consistent Luxury Service at Scale 

 June 09, 2026 

The ultimate test of any organization’s strength is how it scales. Expanding a hotel portfolio introduces new brands, ownership groups, markets and operating models, each with its own set of stakeholders and expectations. Over time, those added layers can complicate and render what should remain the clearest, most fundamental focus of any hospitality business: the guest experience.

For operators managing a growing platform, the challenge is clear: how do you maintain a consistent service culture across hundreds of properties, thousands of associates, and a wide range of brand identities?

results.title: Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality Announce Strategic Merger

Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality Announce Strategic Merger

### Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality Announce Strategic Merger

May 06, 2025

ATLANTA & HONOLULU — Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality today announced a strategic merger, effective May 1, creating a scaled and differentiated hotel management company built to deliver value for hotel owners across branded and independent segments. The merger brings together two complementary organizations with distinct strengths: Hotel Equities, known for its superior performance in branded, select- and full-service assets, and Springboard Hospitality, a leader in managing independent, lifestyle, and resort properties. The combined company will operate a broad portfolio of properties across the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America spanning urban, resort and outdoor destinations.

The newly merged entity will continue to operate as an owner-focused management company, offering tailored strategies backed by institutional-grade infrastructure, deep operational expertise, and a flexible, entrepreneurial mindset.

Ben Rafter, CEO of Springboard Hospitality, is the new chief executive officer of the combined company. Brad Rahinsky, former president and CEO of Hotel Equities, will assume the role of chairman.

“This next chapter for the combined company establishes scale with expanded regional insight and entrepreneurial agility to support owners across every asset class,” said Brad Rahinsky, chairman of Hotel Equities. Ben Rafter, CEO of Hotel Equities, added, “We start with what both companies do best: revenue generation and technology innovation. We’ve earned our reputation by unlocking new revenue opportunities, embracing technology to stay ahead of the curve, and tailoring creative solutions for each asset. From there our combined expertise allows us to move faster, think more creatively, and deliver long-term value in ways that legacy operators simply can’t.”

Al Smith, Hotel Equities’ president of hotel operations, will assume the newly created role of chief operating officer, and Rob Robinson, executive vice president of Springboard Hospitality, will transition to the role of president of Springboard Hospitality.

Hotel Equities’ operational excellence, scaled purchasing power, and expansive North American footprint—combined with Springboard’s entrepreneurial roots and strengths in commercial strategy, technology leadership, and deep expertise in West Coast and Hawaii markets—creates a powerful hospitality platform. This next chapter establishes meaningful scale with expanded regional insight and entrepreneurial agility.

A full suite of services—including operations, revenue management, marketing, food and beverage strategy, capital planning, and development—supported by dedicated teams and a strong track record in both branded and independent environments is offered. Hotel Equities Earns Top Honors in Marriott International’s Q4 2025 Performance Results 

### Hotel Equities Earns Top Honors in Marriott International’s Q4 2025 Performance Results 

 February 13, 2026 

Hotel Equities (“HE”), a best-in-class hospitality operator and developer, has once again been recognized by Marriott International for exceptional performance, earning top distinctions in the global brand’s Q4 2025 results. 

Among the achievements, Hotel Equities earned the #1 Top Performing Franchise Management Company based on Intent to Recommend scores for companies operating 51+ Marriott International Select Brand hotels across the United States and Canada — a key indicator of guest loyalty and brand advocacy.

Hotel Equities was also recognized among the Top 5 Performing Franchise Management Companies in Canada for Topline Activator Scores, reflecting strong revenue performance, market leadership, and disciplined operational strategy across its Canadian portfolio.

In addition, Postcard Cabins Gilchrest Spring, Outdoor Collection by Marriott Bonvoy, ranked among the Top 10 Performing Franchised Hotels in the United States. Notably, this marks the first time a property within Marriott International’s new Outdoor Collection has earned a spot on the Top Performer list — a milestone achievement for both the brand and Hotel Equities.

“From guest satisfaction to topline performance, these results demonstrate the strength of our operating culture and our commitment to delivering consistent excellence for our owners, brand partners, and guests,” said Al Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities.

Marriott’s quarterly performance metrics are widely regarded as a reliable benchmark for evaluating operational effectiveness and financial performance at scale. HE’s consistent recognition across multiple categories reinforces its track record of disciplined execution across a diverse portfolio, strong topline and margin performance, and sustained value creation for its partners.

results.title: Hotel Equities, Springboard promote two key leaders - hotelbusiness.com
results.author: Adam Perkowsky
results.text:
Hotel Equities, Springboard promote two key leaders - hotelbusiness.com

Close

Continue to Site

Al Smith and Rob Robinson

As part of the strategic integration following the merger of Springboard Hospitality and Hotel Equities, the combined hospitality management company has made two key leadership appointments. Albert Smith has been promoted to Hotel Equities COO and Rob Robinson was promoted to Springboard Hospitality president.

“These leadership appointments reflect our commitment to operational excellence and strategic expansion as we continue to unify our platform,” said Ben Rafter, CEO, Hotel Equities. “Rob’s leadership has been instrumental to Springboard’s evolution, and Al brings a proven track record in scaling high-performing hotel portfolios. Together, they will help shape the future of our organization and deliver value to our stakeholders.”

Based in Atlanta, Smith now leads enterprise-wide operations for Hotel Equities, with responsibility for optimizing performance across hotels, resorts and outdoor hospitality destinations throughout the U.S., Canada, the Caribbean and Latin America.

He most recently served as president, hotel operations at Hotel Equities, where he oversaw the strategic management and growth of the company’s hotel portfolio. Prior to joining the company, he was SVP, lifestyle hotels at Highgate, leading a portfolio of independent, full-service luxury hotels across the East Coast. Earlier in his career, Smith held senior roles at Pivot Hotels & Resorts for Davidson Hospitality, Viceroy Hotel Group, SBE Entertainment and Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants.

With more than 20 years of experience in upper-upscale and luxury hospitality, Smith brings a holistic understanding of hotel operations across a range of disciplines, including sales, marketing, revenue management, brand development and talent strategy, according to the company.

Based in Honolulu, Robinson now oversees all aspects of the Springboard Hospitality platform and portfolio, with a focus on driving financial performance, executing long-term growth strategies, fostering a strong company culture and expanding the portfolio across high-growth markets.

Previously EVP of Springboard Hospitality, Robinson originally joined OLS Hotels & Resorts in 2018 as part of its new ownership group and played a key role in the company’s transformation into Springboard. He led the company’s rebrand and spearheaded initiatives that positioned Springboard for national growth.

Robinson’s career spans both the restaurant and hospitality industries, with leadership roles at Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants and Highgate, as well as experience as an entrepreneur, having owned and operated a group of restaurants and bars in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Hotel Equities Named as a Top Performing Franchise Management Company for Premium & Luxury Hotels by Marriott International, Recognized for Exceptional Guest Satisfaction 

### Hotel Equities Named as a Top Performing Franchise Management Company for Premium & Luxury Hotels by Marriott International, Recognized for Exceptional Guest Satisfaction 

 September 04, 2025 

Hotel Equities (“HE”), a best-in-class hospitality operator and developer, today announced it has been recognized by Marriott International as a Top Performing Franchise Management Company in the United States and Canada for Premium & Luxury hotels for the second quarter of 2025. The recognition is based on leading Intent to Recommend (ITR) scores among hotel management companies operating 8+ Premium & Luxury hotels. ITR is a measure of guest satisfaction across Marriott’s portfolio. 

In addition to the overall company achievement, The Farnam, Autograph Collection in Omaha, Nebraska, from Hotel Equities’ managed portfolio, earned recognition among Marriott’s Top 5 Performing Franchised Premium & Luxury Hotels. 

“Our differentiator is the attention to detail that our associates deliver each and every day, and our guests notice and appreciate,” said Al Smith, chief operating officer of Hotel Equities. “I want to congratulate and express my gratitude to the leaders across our organization who set the standard in excellence and consistently prioritize guest satisfaction and comfort as the baseline of true hospitality. These recognitions reflect the passion, precision, and care our entire organization delivers on behalf of our owners and partners.” 

Two of Hotel Equities’ select service properties in Canada, the TownePlace Suites by Marriott Medicine Hat in Alberta and the TownePlace Suites by Marriott Belleville in Ontario, were also recognized as Top Performers for ITR scores. 

Marriott’s performance metrics, including ITR scores, are vital indicators of a management company’s ability to deliver best-in-class guest satisfaction and financial performance. Hotel Equities’ consistent recognition across multiple categories highlights its proven success in optimizing hotel operations, elevating guest loyalty, and maximizing asset value for ownership groups.

Nine Properties Within Hotel Equities Portfolio Awarded AAA Four Diamond Designation 

### Nine Properties Within Hotel Equities Portfolio Awarded AAA Four Diamond Designation 

 August 08, 2025 

Hotel Equities (HE) is pleased to announce that nine hotels within its full-service and lifestyle portfolio have earned the coveted AAA Four Diamond designation. 

Awarded by the American Automobile Association, the AAA Four Diamond rating is reserved for hotels that reflect a high level of hospitality, upscale amenities, exceptional quality, and incredible attention to detail. Joining a select group of just 6% of AAA-rated hotels, these properties represent the gold standard for travelers who seek an elevated, memorable experience. 

“Achieving Four Diamond status showcases the incredible dedication and commitment of our hotel teams to deliver elevated guest experiences,” said Al Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities. “We are extremely proud of our associates and our culture of service excellence and passion for hospitality that shines through every guest interaction.” 

The following properties within the Hotel Equities portfolio have received the AAA Four Diamond: 

- Hotel Northland, Autograph Collection – Green Bay, Wisconsin 
- Hotel Paso Del Norte, Autograph Collection – El Paso, Texas 
- Hotel Retlaw, Trademark Collection by Wyndham – Fond du Lac, Wisconsin 
- The Farnam, Autograph Collection – Omaha, Nebraska 
- The Henry, Autograph Collection – Dearborn, Michigan 
- The Publisher, Tribute Portfolio – Fredericksburg, Virginia 
- The Sound Hotel Seattle Belltown, Tapestry Collection by Hilton – Seattle, Washington (pictured above)
- The Vanguard, Autograph Collection – Ann Arbor, Michigan 
- Tulsa Club, Curio Collection by Hilton – Tulsa, Oklahoma 

The AAA Diamond Program is one of the most respected hotel rating systems in the industry, with rigorous standards upheld through professional inspections. 

For more information on AAA Diamond designations, visit https://www.aaa.com/diamonds/$.
